sloka: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।भर्त्सयन्ति स्म परुषैर्वाक्यै रावणचोदिताः ।। ५.२२.८।।।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ।bhartsayanti sma paruṣairvākyai rāvaṇacoditāḥ ।। 5.22.8।।।।

translations.english: "I shall wait for two months, the deadline fixed. O lady of beautiful hue thereafter you have to share my bed.
